posts.text:
This older guy on Morning Joe was asked about a fake AI video showing a sports commentator being slapped and is like, “I hate that we can’t just enjoy a football game.”

Media: Please stop having clueless, out of touch people on to discuss misogyny and violence.
posts.summary: Criticizes media for platforming uninformed commentators on serious topics
